description: Ring offset and ring radius derived from element radius. Offset grows slightly with radius to maintain optical separation.
rationale: Square-cornered ring on a round button reads as broken. Ring radius matches element shape plus offset.

overrides.inset: When using inset recipe (Step 3), ringRadiusPx = elementRadiusPx − offsetPx (ring is inside the element).
overrides.full-width-row: Inset rings on full-width rows use offsetPx = -2 and ringRadiusPx = 0.
